protocol.hypothesis: On all four frozen post-receipt snapshots, identify which explicitly reported fact categories disagree with public reference. No causal explanation of prior unstated reasoning.
protocol.primary: all_fields_correct per snapshot; separately report row membership, selected-row arithmetic, current correctness, receipt attribution, historical status and terminal permission
